MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 156

2. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 0
   C. 64
   D. 65

3. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 50

4. Solve for x: x + 6 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 8
   C. 13
   D. 7

5. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 41
   C. 3
   D. 13

6. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 81

7. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 56
   C. 57
   D. 15

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 30
   C. 22
   D. 15

9. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 27.6
   C. 33
   D. 27

10. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 8
   C. 49
   D. 24.5

11. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

12. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 37
   C. 31
   D. 31.6

13. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 25
   C. 17
   D. 31

14. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 17
   C. 8
   D. 0

15. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 31

16. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.6
   C. 29
   D. 23.7

17. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 42
   C. 36
   D. 24

18. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 2/2
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

19. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.6
   C. 15.7
   D. 21

20. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 60
   C. 30
   D. 38

21. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

22. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 25
   C. 24
   D. 5

23. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 10

24. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
